title: Code for QS/400 Project
description: A workspace folder mapped to a library or an IFS path (qs400project.json in the folder's root): where Deploy writes and Pull reads.

connection.markdownDescription: The saved connection deployed to, by name (without case), as in `code-for-qs400.connections`.

target.markdownDescription: Where the folder goes: `{ "library": "LIB" }` (a directory per source physical file, a file per member) or `{ "path": "/home/USER/app" }` (the folder's own tree under that path).

library.markdownDescription: The library members are deployed to. `&LIBRARY` and `&SRCLIB` of an action on a local file.

path.markdownDescription: The IFS directory the folder's files are deployed under, as an absolute path.

enumDescriptions: A directory per source physical file, a file per member named MEMBER.ext, the extension from the member's source type. For an IFS target, the folder's own tree.

ifsCcsid.markdownDescription: The CCSID of a stream file a deploy creates. A file that exists keeps its own. The bytes are sent as they are.

ignore.markdownDescription: Globs, relative to the folder, of files never deployed: `*` and `?` within a name, `**` across directories. A glob without `/` matches a name in any directory. `.git/**`, `.qs400/**`, `.vscode/**` and `qs400project.json` are always ignored.

texts.markdownDescription: Member text by local path (`QRPGLESRC/ASSETS.rpgle`), given when a deploy creates the member. A member that exists keeps its own. Pull fills it.

actions.markdownDescription: Actions of this project, as in `.vscode/actions.json`. They override the workspace's by name; a connection's override them.
